description: The dialog to make a chat on a host a Bot (a name, a picture and a memory it reads each time it starts), or change an existing Bot's name and picture.

parts.name: heading
parts.shows: "Make Bot", or "Bot Settings" for an existing Bot.

parts.name: body
parts.shows: Only when making: "A Bot is a chat with a name, a picture and a memory it reads each time it starts."
text: A Bot is a chat with a name, a picture and a memory it reads each time it starts.

parts.name: picture
parts.shows: A round avatar 64px across, centred: the Bot's picture, else its initials from the name typed. Under it two buttons: "Choose Picture…" and (only while there is a picture) "Remove Picture".

actions.does: A file chooser (Pictures) opens; the picture is scaled to fit 256 by 256 and shown. An unreadable one says "Couldn't read that picture: <why>".

parts.name: name field
parts.shows: A text entry with placeholder "Name", pre-filled with the Bot's name, or for a new one the chat's title (80 characters at most); focused. The avatar's initials follow it.

parts.name: Save / Make Bot
parts.shows: The default, suggested-style button: "Make Bot" when making, "Save" for settings; disabled while the name is blank.

actions.does: Sends the name (and picture if changed) to the chat's host, which lists the chat as a Bot. A failure says "Couldn't update the Bot: <why>".
